rules.title: Synthetic Monitoring only
rules.description: Create a ping check, pick probe locations, and read uptime, reachability, and latency on its dashboard. Requires Editor access.

rules.title: Frontend Observability only
rules.description: Create a Frontend Observability application and get the Faro Web SDK snippet that sends real user data.

blocks.title: Digital Experience Monitoring
blocks.description: See how real users experience your app — from the outside in (uptime, speed, from anywhere) and the inside out (real sessions, real errors).

blocks.content: Provisions a starter synthetic check and a RUM snippet in one pass. Illustrative — actual command to be confirmed with the Synthetic Monitoring and Frontend Observability CLI owners.
Whichever you start with, you can add the other half any time from your DEM overview.
